title: A Night To Remember
lyrics:
[00:13.42]Swore I'd seen you before
[00:21.78]Watched you walk through the door
[00:29.95]Somethin' in your eye reminded me of somebody I used to know
[00:46.98]You touched my back
[00:55.23]I took your hand
[01:03.28]Somethin' from your touch felt shockingly familiar
[01:10.08]And I swore I'd seen you before
[01:18.28]Oh, I swore I'd seen you before
[01:26.65]Underneath the sheets
[01:30.81]You enchanted me
[01:35.44]And whispered sweet nothings in my ear
[01:43.83]I shivered beneath you
[01:47.95]All wrapped up in embers
[01:51.75]It was a night to remember
[02:14.52]Then I walked away
[02:23.12]You asked me to stay
[02:31.00]Know you're thinkin' of what could've been
[02:35.93]But you've become someone I've seen before
[02:46.14]I swore I'd seen you before
[02:54.28]Underneath the sheets
[02:58.43]You enchanted me
[03:03.09]And whispered sweet nothings in my ear
[03:11.44]I shivered beneath you
[03:15.68]All wrapped up in embers
[03:19.37]It was a night
[03:22.96]Enchanting night to remember
[03:34.98]Mmm
